name: archify
description: Create validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML with tt-a1i's Archify. Installs the original; its Node CLI runs from the skill folder.

name: architecture-decision-records
description: Write or review architecture decision records. Use for ADRs, significant technology choices, design trade-offs, decision history, or superseding an accepted architectural decision. Overlaps with grilling on trade-offs, planning-with-files on decision notes, harness-decision on decision history, and harness-write on reader-facing rationale; focuses on lasting rationale and supersession.

name: awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
description: Reference guide to gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills for game development with Godot, Unity, Unreal, web, and other engines: gameplay, assets, UI, audio, genres, and publishing. Use /awesome-gamedev-agent-skills to find and read the matching upstream skill. Upstream skills and scripts are not bundled or installed.

name: brainstorming
description: Brainstorm ideas, clarify requirements, compare approaches, and refine designs before implementation. Use for /brainstorming, "brainstorm", "explore alternatives", or "help design this". Overlaps with grilling on questions and trade-offs; focuses on developing alternatives collaboratively.

name: differential-review
description: Review security implications of code changes against a baseline. Use for security reviews of PRs, commits, uncommitted diffs, or removed validation; not for routine formatting or a claim of full-codebase audit coverage. Overlaps with harness-review and pr-review on code review; focuses on reachable security regressions.

name: dri
description: [investigate] Investigate a production incident as a read-only copilot for the on-call DRI: gather evidence, separate facts from hypotheses, and draft next steps and updates. Also holds the proposed DRI-agent design (staged roles, preflight checks, evaluation) while it grows. Service specifics come from the project's private DRI profile. Never changes production or posts updates without explicit approval. Overlaps with harness-monitor on incidents: harness-monitor detects health breaches and proposes work; dri investigates one incident.

name: github-issues
description: Find, draft, create, or update GitHub issues. Use for bug reports, feature requests, issue triage, labels, assignees, milestones, and issue relationships in an explicitly identified repository.

name: graphify
description: Reference guide to the upstream Graphify knowledge-graph skill; its CLI is not installed here. Use to locate authoritative Graphify guidance and its official install workflow.

name: grilling
description: Stress-test a plan, decision, or idea through a staged decision-tree interview. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on trade-offs and planning-with-files on planning; focuses on reaching a shared decision.

name: handoff
description: Prepare a concise continuation note for another session or person. Use for /handoff or an explicit request to save work for a later session. Overlaps with harness-project on context summaries; creates a note rather than a live status view or process-control action.

name: harness-decision
description: [explain|record] List open harness decisions separately from optional configuration, filter closed/all decisions, explain one decision or question, or record a choice. Shorthand: /hn-decision. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on history; owns the compact bulletin, decision register, and read-only explanations.

name: harness-monitor
description: [declare|check|accept|auto] Monitor work across approved source adapters, including ADO and documents; assess relevance, Auto-verify status, correlate explicit requirements, reconcile evidence, and expose verified subsets, or check health observations. `declare` drafts or reuses a monitor's declaration file and saves it; `auto` follows up a source's items or health incidents through an approved local-only worker flow on a schedule. Shorthand: /hn-monitor. Overlaps with harness-work on checks and intake, kpi-dashboard on metric contracts, harness-write on status and owner evidence, and dri on incidents; preserves deferred work and never launches development.

name: harness-project
description: [root|init|migrate|context|clean|policy] Set up and steer a harness project: show status, select or move its root, initialize, migrate layout, show context and register its sources and coding repositories, clean history, and set limits and failure policy, including pause, stop, and resume. Shorthand: /hn-project. Context summaries overlap with handoff. Owns retention; harness-timer schedules maintenance. Bare invocation only lists.

name: harness-review
description: [run] Review current-project changes with two independent reviewers per pass, GPT and Claude Opus, and a whole-repository Fresh pass when no new findings appear, automatically restarting when local files change. Shorthand: /hn-review; explicit scope or options also start a review. Overlaps with pr-review on general review and differential-review on security; PR URLs delegate to pr-review.

name: harness-runtime
description: Shared PowerShell 7 runtime for the harness topics: the harness.ps1 entry point, the runtime guide, and the default review model list. Not invoked directly; use harness-project (setup, context, policy), harness-work, harness-write, harness-review, harness-decision, harness-monitor, or harness-timer.

name: harness-timer
description: [set|disable|resume|clean|migrate] Manage logical schedules under one user-wide heartbeat. Shorthand: /hn-timer. Targets are project, pr, refresh, maintenance, or heartbeat settings. Bare invocation lists only. Overlaps with schedule-manager on task administration; owns SkillVault schedules. Maintenance delegates historical-data cleanup to harness-project clean.

name: harness-work
description: [upsert|run|queue|sprint|test] Add or update tasks; run or queue development, verification, and fixes with the two-reviewer review loop; run goal-based sprints; and declare or run reusable tests. Shorthand: /hn-work. Overlaps with harness-monitor on intake and checks, harness-review on code review, and harness-write on report implementation; sprints can draft status through harness-write. Bare invocation only lists; work starts only with an explicit verb.

name: harness-write
description: [upsert|slots] Draft and update writing for people: evidence-grounded feature docs, onboarding, and troubleshooting guides; stakeholder trackers, meeting invites, and email updates or thread replies; and dashboards, reports, and queries; rank meeting slots offline. Shorthand: /hn-write; upsert takes doc|tracker|meeting|email|report. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on rationale, harness-monitor on status and owner evidence, harness-work on report implementation, kpi-dashboard and jarvis-metrics on report design, and the office-documents and ppt-master references on document output. Drafts only: never sends, invites, shares, or publishes without explicit approval.

name: humanizer
description: Rewrite AI-sounding prose without changing what it says, with blader's Humanizer; overlaps with humanizer-ch on rewriting, while keeping a general-prose scope. Installs the original.

name: humanizer-ch
description: Reference guide to zjqc/humanizer-ch for Chinese critical essays and theoretical commentary. Use /humanizer-ch to locate upstream guidance; overlaps with humanizer on prose editing. Upstream rules and scripts are not bundled.

name: jarvis-metrics
description: Design Jarvis metrics and dashboards from existing Geneva/MDM metrics, Kusto queries, or logs. Use for /jarvis-metrics, Jarvis dashboard creation, metric-source selection, pre-aggregation, dimensions, monitors, and CDS-style success/failure reporting. Overlaps with kpi-dashboard on dashboard/metric design and harness-write on Jarvis authoring; owns Jarvis metric-source plumbing and widget configuration rather than general dispatch or layout guidance.

name: kpi-dashboard
description: Define actionable KPIs and design dashboard layouts, comparisons, filters, and freshness states. Use for /kpi-dashboard, executive SaaS dashboards, MRR/churn/LTV-CAC metrics, operations-center views, cohort retention, or conflicting metric calculations. Overlaps with harness-write on authoring, harness-monitor on metric contracts, jarvis-metrics on dashboard design, powerbi-modeling on grain and measure semantics, and the ppt-master reference on presentation design; supplies reusable, platform-agnostic design guidance, not a platform writer, incident engine, or Jarvis-specific metric-source workflow.

name: office-documents
description: Reference to Anthropic's PDF, Word, and Excel document skills for merging PDFs, cleaning spreadsheets, and document formatting. Use /office-documents to locate the relevant guidance. Overlaps with harness-write on document output and workbook/report validation; upstream tools are not bundled and their proprietary terms apply.

name: openapi-spec
description: Design and validate REST API contracts. Use for /openapi-spec, OpenAPI or Swagger specifications, code-first API documentation, request and response schemas, contract drift, or SDK input specifications.

name: planning-with-files
description: Keep task plans, findings, and progress on disk for long multi-step work with OthmanAdi's planning-with-files; overlaps with grilling on planning and architecture-decision-records on notes. Installs the original; its hooks run local scripts in hosts that support skill hooks.

name: powerbi-modeling
description: Design and review Power BI semantic models, star schemas, fact and dimension grain, relationships, DAX measures, RLS, and performance. Use for /powerbi-modeling, model design, cardinality, cross-filter direction, or model optimization. Overlaps with kpi-dashboard on grain and metric definitions; owns model structure and validation, not dashboard layout or automatic deployment. Design-only use needs no live connection.

name: ppt-master
description: Create native editable PowerPoint (PPTX) decks, reusable templates, brand colors, fonts, and slide layouts with Hugo He's PPT Master; overlaps with harness-write on artifact validation and kpi-dashboard on presentation design. Installs the original, about 13,000 files; its Python tools need their own dependencies.

name: pr-publish
description: [preview|upsert] Create or update your own pull request with a current vs. to-be scenario table. A new PR gets a short description in the style of the GitHub Pull Requests extension's create-pull-request skill and opens ready for review; an existing PR keeps its description and gets only the table. Overlaps with that skill on opening PRs and uses its VS Code tool when available, otherwise gh; pr-review reviews PRs instead. Never pushes or writes to a PR without an explicit ask.

name: pr-review
description: [run|configure] Review a PR URL, repository, or user-wide watchlist; a PR URL alone also starts a review. Overlaps with harness-review on general review and differential-review on security; owns remote selection and isolated evidence, while pr-watch manages targets.

name: pr-watch
description: [add|remove] Manage the single user-wide PR review watchlist. Watchlist changes do not run reviews or change schedules; pr-review owns execution and review results, and harness-timer owns its logical schedule.

name: rag-implementation
description: RAG implementation guidance adapted from wshobson/agents. Use for document Q&A, chunking, retrieval, reranking, and grounded answers. Its examples need dependency and behavior checks; no runtime or data access is bundled.

name: rules
description: [apply|upsert|remove] Put the core and extra rules, or only the four core rules with /rules core, into effect globally (default), in a project, or for this chat; add or change your own global or project rules. The SkillVault rule library changes only when you name extra or core, and persistent rule changes require confirmation.

name: schedule-manager
description: [enable|disable|delete] Manage Windows scheduled tasks, selected by index, list, range, or keyword. Triggers on "/schedule-manager", "schedule-manager", "list schedules", "list scheduled tasks", "enable scheduled task", "disable scheduled task", or "delete scheduled task". Overlaps with harness-timer on enabling/disabling tasks; covers general schedule administration.

name: skillvault-authoring
description: [upsert|remove] Author and maintain skill bundles and catalog entries in the SkillVault repository, not application source or installed copies. Shorthand: /sv-authoring; create and update are upsert aliases. Overlaps with VS Code's agent-customization skill on writing SKILL.md files; use this one only for skills in the SkillVault repository and its catalog. Never installs; use skillvault-installation to install the result.

name: skillvault-discovery
description: [search|evaluate|explain] Discover skills, evaluate candidates, and explain skills, tools, or products. Shorthand: /sv-discovery. Evaluation saves a public-safe assessment unless chat-only; search and explanation are read-only. None installs, runs, or edits the target.

name: skillvault-installation
description: [install|update|uninstall|clean|refresh] Manage installed SkillVault copies and keep them current. Shorthand: /sv-installation. List defaults to installed copies; list catalog inspects sources; clean finds skills that load twice or conflict and shows overlaps, which skillvault-discovery evaluate can judge. Refresh merges upstream changes into adapted skills when push is permitted, then brings new commits to the local checkout and managed global latest copies; scheduling delegates to harness-timer set refresh. Edits no SkillVault source or application code except refresh's adaptation merges; skillvault-authoring owns skill authoring.

name: supabase-postgres-best-practices
description: Review Postgres SQL, schemas, migrations, query plans, indexes, connection pooling, locks, and row-level security. Use for Postgres-backed work; do not apply database-specific advice to SQL Server or other engines.

name: trading-signal-analysis
description: Evaluate historical trading approaches, price patterns, or screenshots through signal-outcome studies. Use for historical backtesting, target-hit and endpoint-close rates, matched-peer benchmarks, percentage-point differences, and lookback, target, or follow-up sensitivity. Keep research distinct from profit claims and trade advice.

name: webapp-testing
description: Verify local web applications with Playwright. Use for browser regression checks, frontend interactions, UI failures, screenshots, and browser console diagnostics.
